name: rate-limits
description: Per-member rate limits on server actions (one database table, no scheduled job).

inserts.marker: <!-- addons: inventory rows (an add-on inserts its own heading and table after this line) -->
inserts.text:
### Rate limits (add-on)

| Table.column | Tier | Purpose | Retention | Deletion path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rate_limits.key | T2 | The limit's name and the member's id ("export:<user id>"), to stop abuse | At most a day after its window | Removed as the limiter runs once older than a day; account deletion deletes the member's rows |
| rate_limits.window_start | T1 | When the current counting window began | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
| rate_limits.count | T1 | Requests in the current window | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
